active_shadow.reason: First Generation-3 enhancement to pass frozen historical walk-forward robustness; no fresh untouched qualification period remains after prior Aug-Sep inspection.

rejected.reason: Meta-gate overfit: excellent calibration but all four frozen walk-forward folds negative.
Causal trade-quality learner became excessively conservative: >99.9% WAIT in tested folds, insufficient trade support, and robust gate failed despite sharply lower drawdown.
rejected.lesson: Do not solve temporal inconsistency by filtering almost every opportunity; add genuinely informative market-state variables and preserve opportunity coverage.

rejected.reason: Genuine funding/OI state improved Gen3C's worst-fold average loss but direct augmentation destabilized profitable regimes, failed robust promotion, worsened worst profit factor and increased worst drawdown.
rejected.lesson: Funding/crowding and open-interest state contain useful information, but should not indiscriminately rewrite the core policy. Future use should be contextual or specialist-separated.

rejected.reason: Causal recent-outcome reliability reweighting materially improved F2 but was not stable across regimes and worsened F4 beyond Gen3C; every frozen promotion-improvement gate failed except coverage.
rejected.lesson: Do not retune the same reliability mechanism after seeing the result. Add genuinely new causal market-state experience, especially order-flow/liquidity context, and test any integration only as a separately frozen generation.

next_frozen_stage.name: MICROSTRUCTURE_EXPERIENCE_TEACHER_V1_1
next_frozen_stage.integration_rule: No Gen3H or other trading challenger may be defined from teacher evaluation outcomes post hoc. First complete V1.1, accept only cross-regime plus cross-symbol stable knowledge, then confirm accepted families on non-teacher symbols from the verified 24-symbol TBT panel. Only after that may a future architecture be pre-registered before its own economic evaluation.

microstructure_experience_teacher_v1_1.full_bank_plan: 16 deterministic shards, max 4 parallel, 4 frozen symbols x 32 frozen dates = 128 symbol-days; training and evaluation states remain physically separated.
microstructure_experience_teacher_v1_1.cross_symbol_upgrade: V1.1 was refrozen before any full-bank evaluation exposure to explicitly require cross-symbol evidence in addition to cross-regime evidence; fixed models/hyperparameters/labels/horizons did not change.
microstructure_experience_teacher_v1_1.broader_confirmation: Any accepted microstructure family must later survive a separately frozen non-teacher-symbol confirmation before integration research.
microstructure_experience_teacher_v1_1.separation: Cannot alter Gen3C authority; any integration requires a separately pre-registered future generation after breadth confirmation.
